relationships.subject: P2X7R
relationships.evidence_quote: The number of pERK-IR Vc neurons in SCC-inoculated rats was significantly reduced by i.c. BBG

relationships.subject: P2X7R
relationships.evidence_quote: It is well known that stimulation of P2X7R triggers activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome, resulting in the production of IL-1β [12].

relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: MHWT was significantly ameliorated by i.c. IL-1RA, but not by i.c. PBS (Figure 6D).

key_findings: Squamous cell carcinoma inoculation upregulated PANX1 in Vc microglia and PANX1 inhibition reduced allodynia and pERK neurons.
P2X7R antagonism and IL-1RA also reduced allodynia; P2X7R agonist restored it despite PANX1 inhibition.
